tool_args.rationale: The authorized mechanism specifies a four-parameter barrier-modulated siphon. Five pilot observations span a broad sink-gradient range, so numerical fitting and fresh confirmation are warranted without another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is 2.0, well above the stated 0.08 ambiguity threshold.
The pilot is subcritical and the high-s_grad probe is not available; the authorized co-activation guidance selects the barrier model.
They do not incorporate the documented sink-gradient inhibition and barrier-siphon co-activation.
